1.w: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord rescued him from the power of all his enemies, including Saul.

2.w: He said: “The Lord is my high ridge, my stronghold, my deliverer.

3.w: My God is my rocky summit where I take shelter, my shield, the horn that saves me, my stronghold, my refuge, my savior. You save me from violence!

4.w: I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and I was delivered from my enemies.

5.w: The waves of death engulfed me; the currents of chaos overwhelmed me.

6.w: The ropes of Sheol tightened around me; the snares of death trapped me.

7.w: In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called to my God. From his heavenly temple he heard my voice; he listened to my cry for help.

8.w: The earth heaved and shook; the foundations of the sky trembled. They heaved because he was angry.

9.w: Smoke ascended from his nose; fire devoured as it came from his mouth; he hurled down fiery coals.

10.w: He made the sky sink as he descended; a thick cloud was under his feet.

11.w: He mounted a winged angel and flew; he glided on the wings of the wind.

12.w: He shrouded himself in darkness, in thick rain clouds.

13.w: From the brightness in front of him came coals of fire.

14.w: The Lord thundered from the sky; the Most High shouted loudly.

15.w: He shot arrows and scattered them, lightning and routed them.

16.w: The depths of the sea were exposed; the inner regions of the world were uncovered by the Lord ’s battle cry, by the powerful breath from his nose.

17.w: He reached down from above and grabbed me; he pulled me from the surging water.

18.w: He rescued me from my strong enemy, from those who hate me, for they were too strong for me.

19.w: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the Lord helped me.

20.w: He brought me out into a wide open place; he delivered me because he was pleased with me.

21.w: The Lord repaid me for my godly deeds; he rewarded my blameless behavior.

22.w: For I have obeyed the Lord ’s commands; I have not rebelled against my God.

23.w: For I am aware of all his regulations, and I do not reject his rules.

24.w: I was blameless before him; I kept myself from sinning.

25.w: The Lord rewarded me for my godly deeds; he took notice of my blameless behavior.

26.w: You prove to be loyal to one who is faithful; you prove to be trustworthy to one who is innocent.

27.w: You prove to be reliable to one who is blameless, but you prove to be deceptive to one who is perverse.

28.w: You deliver oppressed people, but you watch the proud and bring them down.

29.w: Indeed, you are my lamp, Lord . The Lord illumines the darkness around me.

30.w: Indeed, with your help I can charge against an army; by my God’s power I can jump over a wall.

31.w: The one true God acts in a faithful manner; the Lord ’s promise is reliable; he is a shield to all who take shelter in him.

32.w: Indeed, who is God besides the Lord ? Who is a protector besides our God?

33.w: The one true God is my mighty refuge; he removes the obstacles in my way.

34.w: He gives me the agility of a deer; he enables me to negotiate the rugged terrain.

35.w: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend even the strongest bow.

36.w: You give me your protective shield; your willingness to help enables me to prevail.

37.w: You widen my path; my feet do not slip.

38.w: I chase my enemies and destroy them; I do not turn back until I wipe them out.

39.w: I wipe them out and beat them to death; they cannot get up; they fall at my feet.

40.w: You give me strength for battle; you make my foes kneel before me.

41.w: You make my enemies retreat; I destroy those who hate me.

42.w: They cry out, but there is no one to help them; they cry out to the Lord , but he does not answer them.

43.w: I grind them as fine as the dust of the ground; I crush them and stomp them like clay in the streets.

44.w: You rescue me from a hostile army; you preserve me as a leader of nations; people over whom I had no authority are now my subjects.

45.w: Foreigners are powerless before me; when they hear of my exploits, they submit to me.

46.w: Foreigners lose their courage; they shake with fear as they leave their strongholds.

47.w: The Lord is alive! My Protector is praiseworthy! The God who delivers me is exalted as king!

48.w: The one true God completely vindicates me; he makes nations submit to me.

49.w: He delivers me from my enemies; you snatch me away from those who attack me; you rescue me from violent men.

50.w: So I will give you thanks, O Lord , before the nations! I will sing praises to you.

51.w: He gives his king magnificent victories; he is faithful to his chosen ruler, to David and to his descendants forever!”
